description: Lists what the extension saved each time it read this profile in the past, and what changed between reads: name, categories, address, phone, website, hours, description, rating, review and photo counts, claimed state and closure. Use it to spot a suspended or edited profile, or a competitor changing its name or category. History comes from the extension storage, so a profile never read before has none. An id or link this device has seen answers without reading Google; given {name, city}, a short link, or an id the extension has not seen, Maps is opened once to learn the business's ids first. Returns snapshots (readAt and a summary, oldest first) and changes (field, before, after, from, to). A profile field the page or provider did not give is {missing: true, reason}; with absent: true it means Google was read and lists nothing there (no phone on the profile), which is a real gap, while without it the value is simply unknown. Never treat either as 0.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.
